review_mode: read-only; local analytical inspection and direct file-hash verification
question: Do the frozen source-alignment and separate surface-study receipts support their bounded claims without implying likeness acceptance, three-era/browser delivery, or release?
acceptance_criteria: Frozen manifest and reference/source pins verify against local bytes.
Before/candidate camera and render comparability is stated at the level actually recorded.
Geometry/stance/UV preservation assertions distinguish receipt/script checks from independent verification.
Optic, texture, native, browser, three-era, and release claims remain within evidence.
No automated result substitutes for owner artistic acceptance.
source_limitations: Only the evidence role was performed; no outcome, safety-portability, disruptor, or negotiator review is represented here.
Current checkout artifacts and recorded receipts were inspected; no Blender rerender, browser/WebGL run, build, or owner review was performed.
No other QA conclusions were read.

claims.claim: The attempt02 frozen package is byte-consistent with its 23-entry manifest and is tied to the pinned source and shared-goal revision.
evidence: All 23 paths in attempt02/frozen-artifact.json exist and match SHA-256.

attempt01, attempt02, and surface02 receipts pin source assets/models/cinematic-cg-milestone02b/murderbird-cg-2b-builder.blend to 9ba7fc471a86e5f1f9b8db881900725f8abf56546c69fecb125a236ec5b4a64c; direct local hash matches.

claims.claim: Attempt01 and attempt02 use the same saved canon camera transforms, orthographic projection/scale, shift, resolution, and lens; full render-condition comparability is not established by both receipts.
evidence: Saved camera fields match across both receipts for the named views.
Attempt01 receipt does not record global engine, samples, denoising, view transform/look, exposure/gamma, world, or area-light parameters; attempt02 does record them.
The neutral candidate images visibly differ in forms while retaining matching framing; pixels do not prove equal light, exposure, sampling, or tone mapping.

claims.claim: Stance and material-preservation claims are recorded checks, not independent geometry verification by this reviewer.

The inspected scripts implement before/after mesh digests for coordinates, polygon vertices/material indices, UVs, transforms, parent, slot count and visibility; this explains the receipt method but is author-side evidence, not an independent rerun against the native file.

material_evidence_gaps.gap: Attempt01 lacks saved global render and lighting parameters, so equal camera framing is supported but equal effective lighting/exposure/sampling/view transform is not fully evidenced.
material_evidence_gaps.smallest_decisive_test: Record the complete attempt01 scene/render/light state from its preserved native or rerender both candidates with a shared frozen setup.

material_evidence_gaps.gap: Attempt01 lacks saved global render/light parameters, so matching camera transforms and projection are verified but full effective render comparability is not.
material_evidence_gaps.smallest_decisive_test: Recover the exact attempt01 scene/render/light settings from its preserved native or rerender both candidates under one frozen setup.

decision_rationale: The frozen 23-file attempt02 package, source/goal pins, and exact-path texture receipts verify. The earlier texture mismatch was a false positive caused by broad basename search across historical outputs and is retracted with the failed experiment preserved below. Approve this bounded development evidence with limits: attempt01 effective render-state equivalence remains incompletely recorded; the study does not establish final likeness, owner acceptance, browser parity, complete three-era delivery, release, deployment, or engineering validity.
release_limits: May be cited as a source-pinned development geometry and surface checkpoint; all 63 texture hashes match at the exact receipt output paths.
Camera transforms/projection match, but complete attempt01 lighting, exposure, samples, and view-transform equivalence remains unverified from saved receipts.
Do not claim final likeness, owner acceptance, full three-era completion, browser parity, release, deployment, or engineering validity.
review_expiry: Recheck against any regenerated texture receipt, changed native assets, newly produced three-era assets, or fresh browser/build evidence.

retest.trigger: Root identified exact receipt output directories after the original reviewer used broad basename resolution.

original_test_preserved.method: Recursive search under assets/ and public/ followed by hashing basename matches.
original_test_preserved.reassessment: Invalid path resolution: multiple same-named textures exist across historical attempt trees. This experiment is retained for audit history but its conflict conclusion is withdrawn.

era_mapping_check.evidence: src/scene/fallback.js line 15 maps builder to Advanced in eraNames.
era_mapping_check.effect: The saved orange Builder optic aligns with the Advanced optic rule; it does not establish browser parity or three-era completion.

retest.remaining_receipt_ambiguity: The receipt contains two hash sets for distinct exact output locations (49 regional source maps at the surface02 textures root and 14 finish maps in the builder subdirectory). Both byte-verify. This resolves file identity; no independent extraction comparison between packed native image pixels and those files was performed.
retest.scope: Read-only exact-path file hashing and source naming lookup; no native extraction, Blender rerender, build, or WebGL test.
